purpose: Provide an explicit current ^ resolution layer for existing immutable CAEPR records whose historical typed part lacks an embedded identity_resolution field, and record the source-bounded professional/entity relationships required by the caricature/documentary-contrast publication family.
precedence_rule: This file does not create a second identity or replace an immutable CAEPR record. For an ID listed here, CARET_CONFIRMED is the current presentation-marker resolution when the canonical base record has no conflicting later CARET_PENDING or CARET_SUSPENDED state. Any future material collision suspends the affected resolution pending review.
presentation_boundary: A caret confirms canonical identity only. It never proves a role in an unsourced event, shared knowledge, endorsement, coordination, ownership, intent, wrongdoing or liability.
